source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the Castellan’s unit is picked to fight in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), it can take a Leadership test for this ability. A failed test lets its models re-roll 1s to hit on melee attacks. On a pass, its models may also re-roll melee Wound rolls of 1.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

combat.unresolved: The reading's options change no attack.
